sources.title: China Agricultural University 2026 international undergraduate admissions
China Agricultural University 2026 international undergraduate program catalog

requirements.ruleText: Be at least 18, hold or be completing a senior-high-school qualification, have a good academic record, be a non-Chinese citizen with a valid ordinary passport, and be physically and mentally healthy with good conduct.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with current or former Chinese nationality or covered parentage
requirements.ruleText: Meet the published four-year foreign-nationality and overseas-residence rule and submit the applicable naturalization, household-registration cancellation, passport-entry and overseas-study evidence.
HSK Level 4 or above; Veterinary Medicine requires HSK Level 5 with 250 or above.
CSCA: Chinese, Math, Physics, Chemistry

references.locator: Official program workbook, Required Examination Subjects

requirements.ruleText: Upload the passport information page; the passport must expire after December 2026.
Submit the senior-high-school graduation certificate and transcript; pending graduates submit prospective-graduation evidence and the final certificate after admission.
Submit two recommendation letters from subject teachers at the applicant's senior high school.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Record.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with China travel or residence history
requirements.ruleText: Submit Chinese visa information and China border entry and exit records.
Submit a no-criminal-record report issued by the public-security authority.
Submit the original financial guarantee letter and a copy of the guarantor's identification document.
Provide originals or notarized Chinese or English copies and notarized translations when needed; present originals for verification at registration.
Pay the non-refundable CNY 400 application fee.
Submit the complete online application by June 15, 2026.
Participate in CAU's re-examination or interview when invited.
Pay the published tuition for this route: CNY 20,000/year.

sources.title: China Agricultural University 2026 international graduate admissions
China Agricultural University 2026 international master and doctoral program catalog

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen with a valid ordinary passport, be physically and mentally healthy, have no criminal or disciplinary record, comply with Chinese law and university rules, and respect Chinese customs.
Hold a bachelor's-equivalent qualification and be under age 35.
IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 90, or prior degree taught in English, for reviewed graduate routes.
Upload the passport information page; the passport must expire after December 2026.
Submit the notarized highest degree certificate or official student-status and expected-graduation evidence for pending graduates.
Submit complete official transcripts from undergraduate study onward, issued and sealed by the responsible university office; the guide states GPA above 3.0.
Submit two signed recommendation letters from associate professors or scholars with higher academic titles.
Submit study and work experience updated to the application date.
Submit a Chinese- or English-language study or research plan of at least 1,000 words.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Record.
Submit current China visa information.
Submit a no-criminal-record report issued by the public-security authority.
Submit published papers, patents or other academic achievements.
Pay the non-refundable CNY 400 application fee in the CAU system.
Submit the complete application by March-May 2026; final date follows the official website notice.
Participate in any college or department examination or interview when invited.
Pay the published tuition for this route: CNY 26,000/year.

sources.title: Guangdong University of Foreign Studies Fall 2026 international degree admissions notice

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a foreign passport, meet the applicable nationality rules, be physically and mentally healthy, be friendly to China, obey laws and university rules, have good academic standing and conduct, and normally be no older than 30.
Submit scanned high-school graduation and transcript documents, with notarized Chinese or English versions when the originals are in another language.
CSCA Mathematics is required; English-taught applicants do not take the CSCA Chinese subject.

TOEFL 70 or IELTS 5.5 or above; applicants without either may take the university's entrance assessment, and applicants from countries where English is an official language may be exempt from the written English test but still require an interview.
Complete the required entrance assessment, normally a written test and interview or an interview under the published language-exemption rule.
Submit the passport information page, current China visa page when applicable, and a one-inch color identification photograph.
Submit a physical examination report that remains valid.
Submit additional documents requested by the university, which may include recommendation letters or a no-criminal-record certificate.
Register and submit the online application, then confirm the application with the admissions office by telephone or email.
Submit by June 20, 2026.
Pay the published tuition for this route: CNY 33,800/year; the program page separately lists a CNY 500 application fee and CNY 800/year insurance..

sources.title: Shanghai International Studies University 2026 international undergraduate admissions

requirements.ruleText: Hold at least a high-school qualification, be age 18 to 35, be healthy, and have reliable financial support and a guardian where applicable.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants covered by Chinese-parentage or former-Chinese-citizenship rules
requirements.ruleText: Meet the published four-year foreign-passport or nationality-document rule and two-year overseas-residence rule.
Submit the guardian guarantee form; the guardian must be an adult living in mainland China with a source of income.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with prior study or residence in China
requirements.ruleText: Have no record of legal or disciplinary violations during prior study or residence in China.
HSK Level 5 or equivalent Chinese proficiency.
All Songjiang-campus applicants submit CSCA Chinese for Humanities and Mathematics; only the separately named technology, actuarial and data-science routes add Physics or Chemistry.
Submit the graduation certificate and transcript as originals or notarized Chinese or English copies; pending graduates may submit expected-graduation evidence.
Submit the applicable HSK or Chinese-proficiency certificate and the CSCA score report.
Submit the passport copy; applicants graduating from a high school in China must also provide their parents' passport copies.
Submit a no-criminal-record certificate.
Pay the non-refundable CNY 750 application fee or USD 125 overseas-remittance equivalent and upload the payment receipt.
Submit the application by April 15, 2026.
Complete the applicable entrance examination or interview published for the route and campus.
Pay the published tuition for this route: CNY 24,800/year.
